content: a16z's Angela Strange and Gabriel Vasquez discuss the rise of "borderless founders" who combine home-market networks with Silicon Valley resources to build global companies. The next generation of global companies may increasingly launch across multiple countries simultaneously.

title: 刚刚，人类历史上第一次用AI治愈癌症
content: Moderna and Merck announced that their personalized mRNA cancer therapy, intismeran autogene, succeeded in a Phase III trial for high-risk melanoma. The treatment uses AI to identify up to 34 unique cancer mutations per patient, then customizes an mRNA vaccine to train the immune system to attack those specific cancer cells, combined with Merck's Keytruda. The trial met both primary endpoints: recurrence-free survival and distant metastasis-free survival. This marks the first AI-designed therapy to pass Phase III for cancer. The companies plan regulatory filings soon, with potential approval by 2027, and are testing the platform for lung, pancreatic, breast, bladder, and kidney cancers.

title: 我在给 Codex 装一套“AI 监工系统”：施工、验收、回批、停机，全链路自动跑
content: The author is building an autonomous oversight system for Codex, structuring it as a self-regulating construction pipeline: task classification, automated dispatch, self-testing, sealed acceptance packages, independent DeepSeek agent verification, hard-rule gating, minimal rollback, and automatic halt with human escalation on second failure. DeepSeek serves solely as a read-only adversarial inspector without modification or spending privileges. The goal is preventing self-graded work—small tasks run silently, medium tasks get post-completion review, large tasks require plan and result audits, with automatic stops for deletions, releases, costs, or cross-phase changes. The author seeks collaboration from experienced builders of multi-agent, hook-automated systems.

title: 昨夜，DeepSeek Harness首发新版本：14项更新，多模态能力拉满
content: DeepSeek Harness released its first major post-beta update (v0.1.0-rc.8) on August 19, adding 14 features focused on multimodal capabilities. The update enables native image requests and mixed text-image input for commands like /goal and /plan. Claude Code and Codex were added as sub-agents, Windows terminal experience improved with persistent PowerShell sessions, and various bugs fixed. Notably, when models lack vision capabilities, Harness automatically falls back to OCR, color analysis, and pixel scanning tools to extract structured information for text models to process. The framework maintains its "everything is a plugin" design philosophy.

title: Citizens Build, Agents Execute, Experts Govern
content: AI enables non-engineers to build functional software quickly, but this differs sharply from enterprise software engineering. The real scarcity is not coding ability but engineering judgment—designing for security, resilience, scalability, compliance, and operability. Experienced engineers become more leveraged, shifting from writing every feature to governing platforms, guardrails, and practices that let others build safely. The future: citizens create ideas, agents execute code, and experts ensure production-worthy governance.

title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Managing your work
content: The GitHub Copilot app's "My work" pane centralizes pull request and issue management.
